method: Primary author/institution/conference/project pages and papers checked using web browsing; no verbatim paper passages copied

entries.title: Operational Semantics for Multi-Language Programs
entries.supported_comparison: Lump/natural embedding distinction and operational boundary modeling.

entries.title: The Essence of Command Injection Attacks in Web Applications
entries.supported_comparison: Injection as unintended syntactic structure; grammar-based prevention, not a theorem about OSTADIX.

entries.title: Preventing Injection Attacks with Syntax Embeddings
entries.supported_comparison: Syntax embeddings address injection in host/guest compositions.

entries.title: Safely Composable Type-Specific Languages
entries.supported_comparison: Expected types drive delimited literal parsing/elaboration; six authors.

entries.title: Reasonably Programmable Literal Notation
entries.supported_comparison: Typed literal macros; verified exact title/authors/2018 venue and DOI 10.1145/3236801.

entries.title: Context-Aware Scanning for Parsing Extensible Languages
entries.supported_comparison: Scanner uses parser context for lexical disambiguation; not an OSTADIX lexer proof.

entries.title: Eco: A Language Composition Editor
entries.supported_comparison: Incremental composition editor and language boxes.

entries.title: Fine-grained Language Composition: A Case Study
entries.supported_comparison: PHP/Python fine-grained composition; distinct from the 2014 Eco paper.

entries.title: Abstract Interpretation: A Unified Lattice Model for Static Analysis of Programs by Construction or Approximation of Fixpoints
entries.supported_comparison: Abstraction/concretization context; does not supply this implementation with semantic or convergence correctness.

entries.title: Polyglot Programming
entries.supported_comparison: Interop message protocol and supported-language value exchange; no blanket arbitrary-language preservation claim.
